prompt: I've got a chatflow working in the Flowise UI and now I need to call it from our Next.js app, streaming the answer into the UI token by token rather than waiting for the whole thing. I also need to pass the logged-in user's ID through so the flow can personalise. What does the request look like and what do I actually get back on the wire?
assertions: Lists the SSE event names (start, token, metadata, end at minimum)
Notes that metadata arrives after the tokens, before end
Distinguishes sessionId (conversation memory) from vars (values readable in the flow)
Warns that overrideConfig is disabled by default and must be enabled per property
Keeps the API key server-side rather than calling Flowise from the browser
